article.story: KALAMAZOO, Mich. -- — Jaylen Washington's 27 points helped Western Michigan defeat Campbell 87-71 on Sunday. Washington also had five assists for the Broncos (2-1). Rob Lee Jr. added 16 points while going 4 of 6 from the floor, including 3 for 4 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line while he also had nine rebounds. Adam Harakow had 12 points and shot 4 for 10 (1 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line. Rashawn Inglemon led the way for the Fighting Camels (0-2) with 24 points. Lance Waddles added 16 points and 10 rebounds for Campbell. Nordin Kapic finished with 14 points. Western Michigan took the lead for good with 3:17 left in the first half. The score was 41-35 at halftime, with Washington racking up 12 points. Western Michigan outscored Campbell by 10 points in the second half. Up next Western Michigan next plays Thursday against Purdue Fort Wayne on the road. Campbell will visit East Tennessee State on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
